description.value:
This pursuit unlocks discoveries reflecting your grasp of techcasting. Each time you gain a new discovery, you may take one of the following instead, listed alphabetically.

Administrator's Log. Spending at least 10 minutes on a computer or terminal reveals every user who accessed it in the last 24 hours. Given a full long rest afterward, you can forge credentials good enough to pass yourself off as one of those users when accessing systems.

Backdoor Egress. If you're caught inside the area of your own saving-throw tech power, you can use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks; ending that move clear of the affected area lets you skip the saving throw entirely.

Intelligence Core Override (9th level required). Once between long rests, you can cast override interface at 5th level without spending tech points.

Resource Appropriation (11th level required). If you drop your Critical Analysis target to 0 hit points while it still has tech points remaining, you may claim those points for yourself, up to your own tech point maximum. You must finish a short or long rest before using this again.

Skillful Casting. A hit from an at-will tech power requiring an attack roll can be treated as a weapon attack for the purpose of triggering your maneuvers.

Sleeper Program. Casting a tech power with a 1-action casting time, you may choose to delay its activation for up to a minute — casting it normally but holding its energy in reserve, which requires concentration for as long as the delay lasts. If concentration breaks first, the power fizzles with no effect; otherwise you can trigger it at any moment using your reaction.

You can use this feature twice, gaining one more use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, regaining all spent uses after a long rest.
